name: Ofluv Industrial Vehicles — Global SAP S/4HANA Transformation
description: Illustrative operating model for Ofluv Industrial Vehicles's global SAP S/4HANA programme. Twelve value streams across six domains. Order to Cash fully elaborated as reference stream. All other streams are structural stubs.

vs_order_to_cash.name: Order to Cash
vs_order_to_cash.description: End-to-end flow from customer order receipt through fulfilment, invoicing, and cash collection. Primary revenue realisation stream for Ofluv trucks and components across all sales regions.
vs_order_to_cash.terminalOutcome: Cash received and reconciled to order

vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.name: Dealer & Channel Management
vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.description: Management of Ofluv's global dealer network including onboarding, performance monitoring, incentive management, and channel conflict resolution.
vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.trigger: Dealer agreement signed or renewal due
vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.terminalOutcome: Dealer performing at target with active incentive alignment

vs_warranty_returns.name: Warranty & Returns
vs_warranty_returns.description: Processing of warranty claims, product returns, and credit notes across all markets. Interfaces with quality management and supplier recovery.
vs_warranty_returns.trigger: Warranty claim or return request submitted
vs_warranty_returns.terminalOutcome: Claim resolved and credit or replacement issued

vs_service_parts_planning.name: Service Parts Planning
vs_service_parts_planning.description: Demand-driven planning and distribution of spare parts to support global aftersales service commitments and dealer inventory targets.
vs_service_parts_planning.trigger: Parts demand signal from dealer or service network
vs_service_parts_planning.terminalOutcome: Parts available at point of service within committed lead time

vs_source_to_contract.name: Source to Contract
vs_source_to_contract.description: Strategic sourcing activities from spend analysis and supplier identification through RFx, negotiation, and contract execution for direct and indirect categories.
vs_source_to_contract.trigger: Sourcing need identified from category plan or requisition
vs_source_to_contract.terminalOutcome: Supplier contract active and available for purchase orders

vs_purchase_to_pay.name: Purchase to Pay
vs_purchase_to_pay.description: Operational procurement from purchase requisition through goods receipt, invoice matching, and supplier payment across all Ofluv entities.
vs_purchase_to_pay.terminalOutcome: Supplier invoice paid and goods or services received

vs_demand_supply_planning.name: Demand & Supply Planning
vs_demand_supply_planning.description: Integrated business planning process aligning market demand signals with production capacity, supply commitments, and inventory policy across all product lines.
vs_demand_supply_planning.trigger: Monthly IBP cycle or demand signal variance
vs_demand_supply_planning.terminalOutcome: Agreed production and supply plan published to all execution streams

vs_inbound_logistics.name: Inbound Logistics
vs_inbound_logistics.description: Movement of direct materials from suppliers to Ofluv manufacturing sites including transport management, customs, and goods receipt.
vs_inbound_logistics.terminalOutcome: Materials received, inspected, and available for production

vs_production_planning_execution.name: Production Planning & Execution
vs_production_planning_execution.description: Translation of the agreed supply plan into plant-level production orders, scheduling, shop floor execution, and completion reporting.
vs_production_planning_execution.terminalOutcome: Finished goods confirmed and transferred to warehouse

vs_quality_compliance.name: Quality & Compliance
vs_quality_compliance.description: Quality assurance across inbound materials, in-process production, and finished goods, including regulatory compliance for all markets.
vs_quality_compliance.trigger: Quality inspection triggered or non-conformance reported
vs_quality_compliance.terminalOutcome: Product certified compliant or non-conformance resolved

vs_financial_planning_consolidation.name: Financial Planning & Consolidation
vs_financial_planning_consolidation.description: Annual and rolling financial planning, budgeting, and group consolidation across all Ofluv entities and reporting segments.
vs_financial_planning_consolidation.trigger: Annual planning cycle or reforecast trigger
vs_financial_planning_consolidation.terminalOutcome: Approved group financial plan and consolidated forecast published

vs_financial_close_reporting.name: Financial Close & Reporting
vs_financial_close_reporting.description: Month-end and year-end close process including journal posting, reconciliation, statutory reporting, and external financial disclosure.
vs_financial_close_reporting.terminalOutcome: Financial statements published and filed within regulatory deadlines

act_otc_receive_validate_order.name: Receive and Validate Customer Order
act_otc_receive_validate_order.description: Capture inbound purchase orders from all channels and validate against customer master, pricing agreements, and product availability.

activities: Capture purchase order from EDI, portal, or manual channel
Validate order against current price list and discount agreements
Confirm product codes and configuration against SAP material master
Flag incomplete or exception orders for manual review
Acknowledge order receipt to customer within SLA

act_otc_check_credit_availability.name: Check Credit Limit and Availability
act_otc_check_credit_availability.description: Verify customer credit exposure against approved limit and release or block the order accordingly.

activities: Query current customer credit exposure in SAP FSCM
Compare open orders and receivables against approved credit limit
Release order automatically if within tolerance
Escalate blocked orders to credit manager for manual review
Update customer credit master following limit change decisions

act_otc_confirm_schedule_delivery.name: Confirm and Schedule Delivery
act_otc_confirm_schedule_delivery.description: Confirm available-to-promise date with supply chain and schedule delivery to customer location including carrier assignment.

activities: Run ATP check in SAP MM to confirm stock availability
Assign delivery date based on ATP result and carrier lead time
Create outbound delivery document in SAP SD
Notify customer of confirmed delivery date via portal or email
Coordinate with warehouse for pick scheduling

act_otc_pick_pack_dispatch.name: Pick, Pack, and Dispatch Goods
act_otc_pick_pack_dispatch.description: Execute warehouse pick and pack operations and hand goods to carrier for delivery to customer.

activities: Execute transfer order pick in SAP WM or EWM
Confirm picked quantities against delivery document
Pack goods according to shipping specifications
Post goods issue in SAP to trigger inventory reduction
Hand over to carrier and capture proof of dispatch

act_otc_generate_invoice.name: Generate and Issue Customer Invoice
act_otc_generate_invoice.description: Create and issue invoice to customer following goods despatch, applying correct pricing, tax, and entity determination.

activities: Trigger billing run from goods issue or milestone event
Determine correct legal entity, tax code, and output format
Generate invoice document in SAP Billing
Transmit invoice via EDI, e-invoicing platform, or print
Post invoice to accounts receivable and revenue accounts

act_otc_manage_collections.name: Manage Collections and Dunning
act_otc_manage_collections.description: Monitor overdue receivables, execute dunning programmes, and escalate high-risk accounts to credit management.

activities: Run daily overdue receivables report from SAP FSCM
Execute automated dunning letters at configured intervals
Contact customers directly for high-value overdue accounts
Escalate unresolved accounts to legal or collections agency
Record collection activities and commitments in FSCM worklist

act_otc_reconcile_apply_cash.name: Reconcile and Apply Cash Receipts
act_otc_reconcile_apply_cash.description: Match incoming payments to open invoices and post cash application to clear accounts receivable.

activities: Import bank statement and payment advices into SAP
Auto-match payments to open invoices using remittance data
Manually resolve unmatched payments using lockbox details
Post cash application and clear open items in SAP FICO
Escalate unresolved items to credit controller for investigation

act_otc_handle_disputes_returns.name: Handle Invoice Disputes and Returns
act_otc_handle_disputes_returns.description: Resolve customer invoice disputes and process approved returns or credit notes to maintain customer relationship and accurate AR.

activities: Log customer dispute against open invoice in FSCM dispute case
Investigate root cause: pricing error, short delivery, or quality issue
Coordinate resolution with sales, logistics, or quality teams
Issue credit note or corrected invoice upon resolution
Close dispute case and update customer communication log

cap_order_management.name: Order Management
cap_order_management.description: Ability to capture, validate, and maintain customer orders across all channels and regions with full SAP SD integration.

cap_credit_risk_control.name: Credit Risk Control
cap_credit_risk_control.description: Ability to assess, monitor, and enforce customer credit exposure limits in real time across all order and receivables activity.

cap_fulfilment_coordination.name: Fulfilment Coordination
cap_fulfilment_coordination.description: Ability to coordinate available-to-promise checks, delivery scheduling, warehouse execution, and carrier handover.

cap_billing_invoicing.name: Billing & Invoicing
cap_billing_invoicing.description: Ability to generate accurate, compliant customer invoices across all legal entities, tax regimes, and output formats.

cap_collections_management.name: Collections Management
cap_collections_management.description: Ability to monitor overdue receivables, execute dunning programmes, and manage escalation of high-risk accounts.

cap_revenue_accounting.name: Revenue Accounting
cap_revenue_accounting.description: Ability to apply cash receipts, reconcile bank statements, and maintain accurate accounts receivable subledger.

out_otc_credit_approved.name: Credit limit confirmed and order released

out_otc_goods_dispatched.name: Goods picked, packed, and handed to carrier

metric_otc_order_to_invoice_days.name: Order-to-Invoice Cycle Time
metric_otc_order_to_invoice_days.description: Average days from customer order receipt to invoice issuance

metric_otc_dso.name: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
metric_otc_dso.description: Average days to collect payment after invoice issuance

metric_otc_first_pass_invoice_accuracy.name: First-Pass Invoice Accuracy
metric_otc_first_pass_invoice_accuracy.description: Percentage of invoices issued without error or dispute

metric_otc_collection_rate.name: Collection Rate
metric_otc_collection_rate.description: Percentage of invoiced revenue collected within payment terms

ctrl_otc_order_completeness_check.name: Order Completeness Gate
ctrl_otc_order_completeness_check.description: Mandatory field validation on customer order before progression to credit check

ctrl_otc_credit_block_rule.name: Credit Block Rule
ctrl_otc_credit_block_rule.description: Automatic order block triggered when customer exposure exceeds approved credit limit

ctrl_otc_goods_issue_confirmation.name: Goods Issue Confirmation
ctrl_otc_goods_issue_confirmation.description: Warehouse confirmation of goods issue required before billing document creation

ctrl_otc_tax_determination.name: Tax Determination Check
ctrl_otc_tax_determination.description: Automated tax code determination validated against ship-to country and product tax classification

ctrl_otc_invoice_approval_rule.name: High-Value Invoice Approval
ctrl_otc_invoice_approval_rule.description: Invoices above threshold require billing manager approval before transmission

ctrl_otc_dunning_level_rule.name: Dunning Escalation Rule
ctrl_otc_dunning_level_rule.description: Automated escalation to next dunning level based on days overdue and account risk class

ctrl_otc_cash_application_tolerance.name: Cash Application Tolerance
ctrl_otc_cash_application_tolerance.description: Automatic write-off of underpayment differences within approved tolerance band

ctrl_otc_credit_note_approval.name: Credit Note Approval
ctrl_otc_credit_note_approval.description: Credit notes above threshold require sales manager and finance approval before issuance
